name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: Turns any website into clean, structured data an AI app can read instantly, handling all the scraping headaches for you.
buyer: A startup founder building an AI app that needs live web data (price comparisons, research, lead lists) without building scraping infrastructure in-house.
business_use_cases: A price-monitoring SaaS for small e-commerce brands scrapes competitor sites nightly via the API instead of building scrapers in-house.
A recruiting tool scrapes company career pages and job boards to feed a candidate-matching AI.
A market-research freelancer sells 'AI-powered competitor monitoring' reports to small businesses, built on top of the crawl and extract API.

money_ideas.idea: Build a SaaS that wraps the API into a specific monitoring product (prices, jobs, news) and charge monthly.
Sell pay-per-report competitor or market research built on top of the API.

steal_this: Build a simple 'watch these 5 competitor pages and alert me on changes' tool on top of the API and sell it to three local businesses this weekend.
